from pathlib import Path
from src.tools.t01v2_live_progress import read_prefix,archive
root=Path.cwd().resolve();source='pilot_pairs_v2_look60_seq_01_j707558_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan203'
raw,extent=read_prefix(root/'data/world_pairs/v2'/(source+'_attempts.jsonl'))
selected=[json.loads(x) for x in raw.splitlines() if x.strip()]
selected=[r for r in selected if r['status']=='passed' and r['kind'].startswith('look_') and r['pair_id']!='floorplan203_00001']
assert selected
out=root/'logs/review/t01v2_look_fov60_batch_02';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
proofs=[]
for row in selected:
 p=(root/row['pair_file']).resolve();p.relative_to(root/'data/world_pairs/v2')
 rawpair=p.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(rawpair).hexdigest()==row['pair_sha256']
 d=json.loads(rawpair); ref=d['review_image'];png=(root/ref['file']).resolve();png.relative_to(root)
 blob=png.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()==ref['sha256']
 target=out/(row['pair_id']+'.png');target.write_bytes(blob)
 proofs.append({'journal_row':row,'original_review':ref,'published_file':str(target.relative_to(root))})
proof={'scope':'provisional generator-passed additional Look pairs; running source, independent final checkpoint pending','source_run':source,'field_of_view':60,'pairs':proofs,'journal_prefix':archive(raw,out,'source_journal.prefix'),'journal_extent':extent}
(out/'provisional.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
(out/'README.md').write_text('Additional unchanged60-degree Look review images from running FloorPlan203. These are generator-passed candidates; ended-source independent acceptance remains pending. The completed six-unit cohort and human image review still govern expansion and FOV choice.\n')
print(json.dumps(proof,sort_keys=True))
